about_the_game:
Deskripted sak.

It's Skrot-Robot time is a simple 2d-puzzle casual game.

Work your way onwards in a series of different levels, defended by robots and supply goods.

Fight off the desekrated variants of 'skrot-robots', with equipment and gun-weapons.

Collect gold coins, gather xp, level-up, upgrade equipment and specialize the character with specific skills to be able to develop further onto the creep, coming from the robots and its robot-base.

At the moment 5 levels are playable.
Get at least 1 star on a level to unlock the next one, - each with its own set of robots and supplies. Descend outwards onto the wilds, dry fields, and industries.

Developed base from new, but kinda like games such as Dungeon Raid.

Advance from desolate places, later reach robot-base, with a damaging machine-gun and other types of gear.
Destroy all in its path, and leave nothing but garbage waste in its remnants.

name: It's Skrot-Robot Time!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows XP / Vista / 7 / 8 / 10
  • Processor: 1 GHz
  • Graphics: 1366x768 min resolution - recommended graphics card with 128 MB RAM
  • Storage: 70 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: In general all 16:9 and 16:10 screen resolutions are supported. Even though the game could work on other screen resolutions - it is not guaranteed that things will look decent. Playing the game on lower than 1366x768 is dissuaded.

short_description: It's Skrot-Robot time is a simple 2d-puzzle casual game. Set out with 1 of several soldier-like class-types. Obliterate robots with guns. Upgrade with new gear and different skills later on. Be the resistance fighter needed to stand off against the devastating skrot-konstrukts.
